data.name: Jaamiyaht
data.gender_notes: Jaamiyaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A place where knowledge is gathered and nurtured, like a garden. Derived from the Arabic word 'Jaama'ah' which means 'a group, gathering, or assembly'. The name Jaamiyaht carries the meaning “Gathering, knowledge, garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jaamiyaht usually hope their child will grow to embody gathering, knowledge, garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jaamiyaht represents the spiritual pursuit of knowledge and growth, as well as the nurturing and cultivation of the self and one's community.
data.etymology: Jaamiyaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gathering, knowledge, garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaamiyaht total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جاميحت
in_arabic.long_meaning: جاميحت هي كلمة عربية تعني الجمع أو التجمع، وهي مشتقة من الجذر الجمع، وتستخدم في السياق الإسلامي لوصف التجمع أو الجماعة، وهي مفهوم مهم في الإسلام حيث يشير إلى أهمية الوحدة والاجتماع

in_urdu.name: جامیحت
in_urdu.long_meaning: جامیحت ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اکٹھا ہونا یا جمع ہونا، یہ لفظ جمع کے عربي gốc سے لیا گیا ہے، اور اسلام میں اس کی اہمیت ہے کیونکہ یہ اتحاد اور اجتماع کی ضرورت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जामियहत
in_hindi.long_meaning: जामियहत एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है एकत्र होना या संग्रहित होना, यह शब्द अरबी मूल जमा से लिया गया है, और इस्लाम में इसका महत्व है क्योंकि यह एकता और संग्रह की आवश्यकता को दर्शाता है
